name: オーロラ
code: const yc = H * .4 + Math.sin(p.x * .006 + t * .4 * sp) * H * .12 + Math.sin(p.x * .015 - t * .7 * sp) * H * .04, yo = Math.sin(p.a * 3) * H * .16 * p.k; p.vx = p.vx * .94 + (.12 + .06 * Math.sin(p.a + t * .5)) * sp; p.vy = p.vy * .9 + (yc + yo - p.y) * .008; if (d < 240) { const w = 1 - d / 240; p.vy += Math.sin(d * .05 - t * 4 * sp) * 1.2 * w; p.vx += Math.cos(d * .05 - t * 4 * sp) * .3 * w; }
